The '''Utapaun bident''' was both a range and melee weapon wielded by the [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] warriors of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. As the name suggested, it was a two-pronged version of a [[Trident/Legends|trident]].

The bident, while ostensibly a forked spear, featured a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] that fired green bolts through the gap between the weapon's prongs. Pau'an warriors, armed with bidents and shields, fought in the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]], riding into combat over [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] astride [[Dactillion/Legends|dactillion]] mounts.
